title: impeccable: the same AI, a different design

facts.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit.

scenes.heading: SAME AI. SAME BRIEF. WATCH THE DESIGN CHANGE.
scenes.sub: impeccable · design vocabulary for coding agents
scenes.say: Same coding agent, same brief. Watch the design change with Impeccable.

scenes.heading: impeccable
scenes.sub: a design vocabulary for your coding agent
scenes.say: It's called impeccable. It gives your coding agent words for design: polish, bolder, critique and audit.

scenes.heading: TWO COMMANDS
scenes.say: From your project root, run npx impeccable install. Then run slash impeccable init in your agent.

scenes.heading: WITHOUT, THEN WITH
scenes.say: Without it, the page is a cream layout with pill buttons. With it, the page is built around one picture.

scenes.heading: WHAT TO KNOW
scenes.say: Run the install from your project root, then reload your coding tool. It works with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, among others.
